email.subject: Thank You For Applying!
email.body:
Hi Candidate,
Thank you for your interest in Zeno Group.
We wanted to let you know we received your application for Senior Vice President, AI & Technology Programs and we are delighted you would consider joining us.
Our team will review your application and will be in touch if your experience and qualifications match our needs for the role. If you are not selected for this position, keep an eye on our jobs page as we are growing and adding openings.
Best,
The Zeno Talent Acquisition Team
This email was intended for candidate@example.com
